name: leather leggings
_design_note: F1-30 light legs slot. Boiled leather thigh-to-knee. Leggings_of_Enkidu uses this as template_basis. Scouts and skirmishers wear these over heavier alternatives.
lore_template: Scouts choose leggings of {material_name} before any heavier kind, since a protected leg is of no use if it cannot run. Each is shaped from thigh to knee in one piece that bends with the stride.
